card.ruler_checked_note: Legacy A6 fixture metadata only. Field capture uses the A4 PDF; metric scale and depth calibration use card.marker_mm.

camera.note: Pose camera matrix built from EXIF FocalLengthIn35mmFilm when present; falls back to EXIF focal/sensor width (6.17mm is a guess, up to 58% off real phones) then 4.0mm. max_pose_reproj_err_px rejects degenerate poses (scale is unaffected).
